result.summary: Several layout and content issues: restaurant cards and category chips are clipped, a popular listing is missing its name/details, and the last tab-bar icon is incomplete.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccol) is cut off at the right edge, hiding part of the name and image.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal carousel has enough padding/peek or allow wrapping so the last card is fully visible.

issues.description: The category filter chips overflow the screen; the last chip is only partially visible with no indication of more options.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal scrolling affordance, fade, or wrap so all categories can be reached and the last chip isn't clipped.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card shows only an image, discount badge, and favorite icon—no restaurant name, rating, delivery time, or cuisine.
issues.suggestion: Show the same metadata as the card above (name, ETA, delivery fee, cuisine, rating) so the listing is identifiable and tappable.

issues.description: The profile/account icon in the bottom tab bar is clipped on the right.
issues.suggestion: Increase tab-bar padding or scale icons so all four items sit fully inside the safe area.

issues.description: Restaurant name is truncated as 'Trattoria Piccol' without ellipsis or full title.
issues.suggestion: Use ellipsis or a two-line title so the full restaurant name is readable.
